title: 第三章 梁家祖坟，有人先死后哭
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

梁家门楼修得比小县衙还气派。

朱漆大门，石狮镇宅，门口一左一右挂着白灯笼。白纸糊得极厚，风吹过时，灯笼里影子晃动，像有人在里面低头走路。

沈清萝到的时候，梁家二叔亲自迎出来。

他四十来岁，穿锦袍，腰间系玉佩，脸上挂着笑，眼底却有一圈青黑。

像很久没睡过安稳觉。

“沈姑娘可算来了。”

梁二叔热情上前。

“玄司说您是槐荫坡最会守墓的人，梁家上下这几日被闹得不得安宁，全指望您。”

沈清萝看了一眼他伸过来的手。

“定金。”

梁二叔笑容一顿。

管家连忙递上银票。

沈清萝接过，当场展开，对着天光看水印。

梁二叔眼角抽了一下。

“沈姑娘这是……”

“验钱。”

“梁家不至于赖这点钱。”

沈清萝把银票收好。

“赖钱的人都这么说。”

阿青藏在引魂铃里，笑得差点出声。

梁二叔脸色不太好看，但还是忍了。

“姑娘一路辛苦，先入府喝杯茶，晚些再去祖坟。那东西夜里才闹，白日看不出什么。”

沈清萝：“先看坟。”

“这……”

“我是来守墓，不是来喝茶。”

梁二叔的笑僵住。

片刻后，他袖中滑出一个小荷包，递到沈清萝面前。

“姑娘年纪轻，做事有规矩是好事。只是我大哥死后怨气极重，常来惊扰家宅。若今晚见着他作祟，还请姑娘直接收了，别多问。”

沈清萝看着荷包。

“封口钱？”

梁二叔脸色微变。

“姑娘说笑。”

“我没笑。”

沈清萝绕过那个荷包。

“梁二爷，我收钱办事，但不收钱闭眼。鬼若害人，我收。人若害鬼，我也查。”

梁二叔眼底那点热情彻底凉了。

“沈姑娘，梁家花重金请你来，不是请你来审梁家的。”

沈清萝回头。

“那你请错人了。”

气氛一下僵住。

旁边管家赶紧打圆场：“二爷，祖坟那边还等着，不如先带沈姑娘去看看？”

梁二叔深吸一口气。

“好。”

梁家祖坟在城北乌鸦岭。

一路上，梁二叔都在说梁家长房的事。

他说梁大爷梁正德生前体弱，死前病得糊涂，常疑神疑鬼，说有人要害他。死后头七还没过，祖坟就开始哭，夜里阴风大作，家中鸡犬不宁。

他说得很顺。

顺得像背过。

沈清萝听到一半，问：“梁大爷死了多久？”

“两个月。”

“病了多久？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The gatehouse of the Liang family is even more impressive than the small county government office.

There is a vermilion-lacquered gate, a stone lion townhouse, and white lanterns hanging on the left and right of the door.The white paper is extremely thick. When the wind blows, the shadows in the lanterns sway, as if someone is walking with their head down inside.

When Shen Qingluo arrived, the second uncle of the Liang family personally greeted her.

He was in his forties, wearing a brocade robe and a jade pendant around his waist. He had a smile on his face, but there was a circle of black and blue under his eyes.

It's like I haven't had a good night's sleep in a long time.

"Miss Shen is finally here."

Uncle Liang stepped forward enthusiastically.

"Xuansi said that you are the best tombkeeper in Huaiyinpo. The Liang family has been in trouble these past few days, and they are all counting on you."

Shen Qingluo glanced at his extended hand.

"Deposit."

Uncle Liang smiled.

The butler quickly handed over the banknote.

Shen Qingluo took it, unfolded it on the spot, and looked at the watermark against the sky.

Uncle Liang's eyes twitched.

"Miss Shen, this is..."

"Check the money."

"The Liang family won't rely on this little money."

Shen Qingluo put away the banknotes.

"That's what people who want money say."

Ah Qing was hiding in the soul-inducing bell and almost laughed out loud.

Uncle Liang's face didn't look good, but he still endured it.

"Girl, you've been working hard all the way. Let's go to the house for a cup of tea first, and then go to the ancestral grave later. That thing only makes trouble at night, so you can't see anything during the day."

Shen Qingluo: "Look at the grave first."

"This..."

"I'm here to guard the tomb, not to drink tea."

Uncle Liang's smile froze.

After a moment, he slipped a small purse out of his sleeve and handed it to Shen Qingluo.

"Girl is young, and it's a good thing to have rules in doing things. It's just that my eldest brother was very resentful after his death and often came to disturb the house. If you see him causing trouble tonight, please just take it away without asking any questions."

Shen Qingluo looked at her purse.

"Hush money?"

Uncle Liang's face changed slightly.

"Girl is joking."

"I'm not laughing."

Shen Qingluo walked around the purse.

"Second Master Liang, I charge money to do things, but I won't close my eyes if I don't charge money. If ghosts harm people, I will accept them. If people harm ghosts, I will also investigate."

The enthusiasm in Uncle Liang's eyes completely cooled.

"Miss Shen, the Liang family spent a lot of money to invite you here, not to ask you to interrogate the Liang family."

Shen Qingluo turned around.

"Then you hired the wrong person."

The atmosphere suddenly froze.

The butler next to him quickly smoothed things over: "Second Master, we are still waiting at the ancestral graves. Why don't we take Miss Shen to have a look first?"

Uncle Liang took a deep breath.

"Okay."

The ancestral grave of the Liang family is in Crow Ridge in the north of the city.

Along the way, Uncle Liang was talking about Liang's parents' room.

He said that Uncle Liang Liang Zhengde was weak during his lifetime and was confused by illness before his death. He was often suspicious and said that someone was trying to harm him.Before the first seven days after death, the ancestors begin to cry in their graves. There is a strong wind at night, and the chickens and dogs in the house are restless.

He spoke smoothly.

It's as smooth as carrying it.

Shen Qingluo heard half of it and asked, "How long has Uncle Liang been dead?"

"Two months."

"How long have you been sick?"
